page0.text:
"What is the problem? Why do you hesitate? The Grail itself is at stake. It seems a reasonable offer to me."
The priest's words ring true.
For her to hesitate now would be the height of hypocrisy.
Even still...
This path...isn't wrong...
His words refuse to leave her mind.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page0:1

page1.text:
"I...I..."
Though it disgusts her, she knows she's nothing like Shirou.
She wants to upend everything.
That day, so long ago, there must have been someone who would have drawn the sword from the stone and been a better king.
There must have been someone who could have built a true utopia...
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page1:1

page2.text:
The heart that loved her nation so dearly...
And the young woman's doubt...before she took the sword.
On that day...
She tried to fully and forever abandon her heart the day she drew the sword.
...
How did she not realize this before?
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page2:1

page3.text: "I can't stray from this path, for all those who were left behind, who laid it."
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page3:1

page4.text:
To her, that is the girl who loved her country. The girl named Altria, before she was crowned.
That was not a kingly heart.
A king could only believe in themselves.
To deny that would be to deny everything she gave up.
What is lost cannot be returned.
Her Master insisted on this, even as he suffered.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page4:1

page5.text:
...
His pained expression alone makes her heart ache.
What was it she had said?
She could not start over.
It was her duty as the king. So she refused, over and over.
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page5:1

page6.text:
What duty?
To resurrect her lost nation?
To select a more capable king?
Or is it...to wish for all the death and destruction to have never happened to begin with?
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page6:1

page7.text:
"...No, that isn't right."
That was a mistake.
She was raised to be king. That is how she lived.
In that, there was no flaw.
But if that led to ruination, why could she not accept it?
She had no regrets.
If she could take pride in the way she lived her life, wishing for another chance was a pointless waste.
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page7:1

page8.text:
"...I see it now, Shirou."
And so his anguished cries finally reach her heart.
All the tears.
All the pain.
Even her broken heart.
Salvation could come from destroying all of it.
But...
If it was undone, what would happen to everything swept aside in the undoing?
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page8:1

page9.text:
I have stolen much from many. Even their very lives.
All that pain and regret is mine to bear. It belongs to me.
If I were to wish for a chance at something, it should be for a miracle in the here and now, not to upend the past.
Each of the countless paths not taken before...
...cannot be taken by sacrificing this one. Instead, I should forge ahead and work to fulfill what hopes have yet to come true even to this day.
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page9:1

page10.text:
...
If she is nationless and uncrowned now...
...perhaps her wish should be for herself—
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page10:1

page11.text:
No.
She could not make a wish like that, either.
She chose to take up the crown.
She never suffered for that decision. Not once.
Even if no one ever understood or accepted her...
That choice itself was her pride and joy.
At the very least...
She truly believed that when she drew the sword from the stone.
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page11:1

page12.text:
That is her answer.
Just as he found something to stand by, so too has she.
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page12:1

page13.text:
"Yes..."
She pledged once, so long ago...
Something she swore to herself.
She would fight.
Even if she loses everything...even if everyone in the world hates her.
"...I was so foolish..."
An oath from a king. A promise to fight against all odds.
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page13:1

page14.text:
And so the king protected her country.
But the country did not protect the king.
And so it was. The ending may have been tragic, but if she is no longer ashamed of the path that led there...
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page14:1

page15.text:
"I should never have pursued that wish."
She fulfilled her duty as king.
It led to ruin, but she saw everything through to the end.
There need be nothing else.
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page15:1

page16.text:
Of course.
I did not want everything.
The only thing I ever wanted from the very start...
I did until the very end, even if it meant losing so much along the way.
I will keep this unobtainable dream deep within my heart...
...and it may now end.
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page16:1

page17.text:
"...I do desire the Holy Grail. But I cannot kill Shirou."
She turns her sword on her enemy.
"...What?"
"Do you not understand, fool? Shirou is more important to me."
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page17:1

page18.text:
And that is why my role is set.
I will be his sword. I will shield him from danger.
All hesitation leaves her.
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page18:1

page19.text:
"...You are saying you do not want the Grail?"
"If the Holy Grail will stain me, I do not want it. I already have everything I want."
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page19:1

page20.text:
Yes. She has everything she needs with her now.
Her pride as a knight. Her promise as a king.
Even the precious dream that young girl once held...
page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page20:1

page21.text:
Those words... Those words I do hear.
The girl who professed that her only goal was claiming the Holy Grail...
...now says she has no need of such a thing.
page21.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page21:1

page22.text:
"Sa...ber..."
I call out to her as loudly as I can between ragged breaths.
My vision still hasn't cleared, but I can still make out her presence.
The pain is fading.
My wound, which wouldn't close, begins to heal. Is it because she's close?
page22.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page22:1

page23.text:
"Can you stand, Shirou? If you can, please take my hand."
"...Yeah...I can do that..."
I take her hand.
Whoa...
My vision returns.
My head, so fuzzy from blood loss, rapidly regains focus.
page23.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page23:1

page24.text:
"...Saber...is this your...?"
"Yes. It can negate even the curse of Gáe Bolg. Stay close to me, and you will heal completely.
We must press on, though..."
page24.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page24:1

page25.text:
Saber turns her gaze back to the underground sanctuary.
Beyond the door...
...the last Master, Kirei Kotomine, stands at the threshold to the room. Beyond him is Lancer.
page25.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page25:1

page26.text:
"I see."
He looks at us strangely, as if seeing us for the first time.
"How dull."
The disappointment in his voice is palpable.
page26.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page26:1

page27.text:
"It appears the Holy Grail is mine, then.
...But that will be rather violent.
If my wish is to be granted, it will require a completed Grail. Regretfully, I must kill you here, Shirou Emiya."
page27.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page27:1

page28.text:
"Hn!"
I try my best to brace myself, but my body still won't listen.
Even with Saber's hand in mine it's all I can do just to stand.
I can't possibly fight, so I'll only be a burden to Saber—
page28.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page28:1

page29.text:
"Do not concern yourself with this. I will handle it. Please just stay here."
"Such confidence. What say you, Lancer? Do you think it would be wise for us to flee?"
page29.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page29:1

page30.text:
...
Lancer is silent.
Of course, Kotomine doesn't actually sound at all worried.
He's just making a show of it.
page30.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page30:1

page31.text: "Kotomine. Before I cut you down, I will ask, what exactly do you hope to gain? What is your wish, Overseer?"
page31.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page31:1

page32.text:
"...In a word, 'entertainment.' But I am in no rush.
To be honest, I have little interest in the Grail itself. But that is fine. If none prove worthy, I will take it, for the sake of the world itself."
page32.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page32:1

page33.text: "You must think me a fool. You slay a Master to become one yourself, but claim innocence? You intended to pursue the Holy Grail from the start."
page33.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page33:1

page34.text:
"You jest, but it is the truth. I came to this situation by happenstance. Lancer's Master had to die. Outsiders are trouble. I would not want them to discover the Grail's nature. So I was forced to retire that Master early. Still, it would not have been wise to eliminate the Servant at that stage.
I needed a pawn to hasten the war's conclusion, so I borrowed that Master's rights to Lancer."
page34.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page34:1

page35.text: The hell? Kotomine became a Master by killing Lancer's!?
page35.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page35:1

page36.text:
"...I see. Then I need no further information from you.
I would, however, have you fulfill your duty, Overseer. Where is the vessel? Where is the heart of this war?"
"What? Did you not realize you had it to begin with...?"
page36.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page36:1

page37.text:
He actually gasps.
The brief moment of surprise passes quickly.
With a smirk, he snaps his fingers to introduce the final piece of the puzzle.
page37.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page37:1

page38.text:
"Wha—"
Both Saber and Lancer tense.
Heavy footsteps echo from above.
page38.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page38:1

page39.text:
"I suppose it is hardly necessary any longer, but let me introduce you. This is the Servant, Archer. He is the Heroic Spirit I partnered with in the previous Holy Grail War."
The golden figure makes his appearance.
Gilgamesh, King of Heroes.
page39.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page39:1

page40.text:
The atmosphere shifts.
After making his sudden appearance, Gilgamesh crosses the sanctuary grounds to stand beside Kotomine.
page40.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page40:1

page41.text:
"...So? What are your plans now, Kotomine? Are we settling the score with these worms here?
This is rather an underwhelming venue."
page41.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page41:1

page42.text: "Please, do not say that. This did not conform to my expectations either. Forgive me. Allow me to address all your complaints later."
page42.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page42:1

page43.text:
"All right, as long as you understand.
But do something about this primitive, would you? If he continues to fix his ugly little gaze on me, I may be forced to kill him."
page43.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page43:1

page44.text: "The hell is this, Kotomine? That guy's your Servant...?"
page44.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page44:1

page45.text:
"Ah, yes, I have not explained everything to you. He is my Servant from the previous war. We had a mutual understanding at its conclusion.
As he felt following me was acceptable, and I prepared suitable sustenance for him to remain, we have been content to continue our cooperation."
"So that's why you keep that disgusting room. And why didn't you tell me about this?"
page45.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page45:1

page46.text:
"What would have been the point? Did you want to partner with him for your tasks?"
"Hell no. I'd rather die than work with him."
...
page46.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page46:1

page47.text:
...And now there are three of them.
Lancer by the stairs. Gilgamesh in the center of the sanctuary.
page47.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page47:1

page48.text:
"Gh."
We can't beat them all.
Gilgamesh is too much for us on his own. But we can't escape with Lancer around, either.
page48.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page48:1

page49.text:
"Kotomine, you said you didn't know about him..."
"Please. I am a priest. I do not lie."
"Huh? You're lying! You said you couldn't ignore a Servant from the previous war!"
page49.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page49:1

page50.text:
"Correct. I was, in fact, surprised at the time as well. I had intended for Archer to remain here, but he still went out to do battle with you.
Should you have been the one to investigate Archer, you would have discovered all this. As such, I was forced to make plans. So, you see, I did not lie."
page50.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page50:1

page51.text:
"Guh...!"
God dammit!
I blundered right into the enemy's stronghold because I trusted his word!
page51.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page51:1

page52.text:
"...Then you are Archer's Master?"
"Correct. It feels like a renewal of the war from ten years ago, yes?
I was obviously unable to witness the final moments after Kiritsugu defeated me. This shall be the second—and final—time I face you."
page52.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page52:1

page53.text:
"Answer me: How and why does Archer remain? What caused the fire? And how are you alive after Kiritsugu defeated you!?"
Saber's voice drips with venom.
These questions must have been weighing on her for a while now.
She must also want clarity about what she left behind ten years ago and the disaster that followed.
page53.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page53:1

page54.text:
"There should be no question.
Ten years ago, the Grail was incomplete, yet filled with power. It was within reach.
So I touched it. You and Kiritsugu proved too strong and I wished for a diversion to separate the both of you. What ensued shocked even me."
page54.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page54:1

page55.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page55:1

page56.text: "...You caused the fire with the Grail!?"
page56.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page56:1

page57.text:
"Perhaps. Had I been someone else, the Grail may still have done the same, or at least something similar. That is in its nature. It is called the omnipotent chalice, but only blood, darkness, and curses fill it.
Did you not witness that as well? What emerged when you destroyed the vessel bathed Archer in its darkness. Perhaps he would not have become lost in this world had you not destroyed the Grail."
page57.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page57:1

page58.text: "Cease your drivel. The Holy Grail is a wish-granting vessel. It grants the wishes of the one to possess it, so you must have wished for that fire...!"
page58.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page58:1

page59.text:
"I only wished for what resulted. I had no such designs on the process by which it happened. I merely desired that everyone be gone from that place.
You, on the other hand, seem to be lacking in imagination.
Grant wishes? Certainly. But how will a wish be granted? Did you expect the world to change instantly?"
page59.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page59:1

page60.text:
...
"I do not know what the original Holy Grail might have been, but this one is merely concentrated power.
It is incapable of calculations or corrections. It is simply a power source.
Think of it like a weapon. If the one who possesses it wishes for riches, it will kill all around them, thus granting its possessor their riches—their wish."
page60.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page60:1

page61.text:
"Do you understand? It is a defective vessel that can only grant wishes through destruction."
"Wha—That is not what was promised...!
The Grail is supposed to grant any wish to the one who possesses it!"
page61.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page61:1

page62.text:
"And so it does. The Grail's methodology, though, is brutally practical, I daresay.
Sometimes, for one to live, another must die.
Such equivalent exchange can be found all over the world. A miracle would require a means by which to make itself possible.
A wish does not come true if one is concerned about things like equity.
To enact such a paradigm shift would require the sacking of that which is lesser. An alteration via the most efficient method."
page62.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page62:1

page63.text:
...
I can only imagine what Saber must feel.
If what Kotomine says is true, this is not the Grail she wanted.
page63.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page63:1

page64.text:
It's merely power to fuel the possessor's wish.
It grants its owner's wish, at the cost of everything else.
So that is the true face of this supposedly omnipotent power.
page64.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page64:1

page65.text:
"Then...the Grail..."
"It is a tainted vessel that destroys all but its bearer.
You will understand once you lay eyes upon it. It is truly a curse given form."
page65.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page65:1

page66.text:
"And that...is a delight to my ears.
To touch the Holy Grail is a dream for a man of the cloth such as myself. But this Grail would kill everything and everyone. To hold such power in my hands would be a dream come true."
page66.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page66:1

page67.text:
The priest laughs.
This time, it's not for show.
He laughs in pure delight.
It makes me realize...
This is a man entirely without humanity.
More than anyone else, he absolutely cannot get the Grail.
page67.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page67:1

page68.text:
"...Farewell, then.
See to this garbage. Lancer, kill the boy. Archer, defeat Saber."
page68.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page68:1

page69.text:
The priest turns on his heel and ascends the stairs.
All that remains are me, who can barely move from my injuries, Kotomine's two Servants...
...and Saber, standing ready to guard me, glaring at our enemies.
page69.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page69:1

page70.text:
A tense moment passes.
We need to beat Gilgamesh and Lancer if we're going to have any hope of getting back to the surface.
But I don't care about defeating them.
If we could regroup somehow, maybe, but—
page70.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page70:1

page71.text:
"Shirou."
Saber's voice is quiet, but her eyes never leave the enemy.
"I know I am asking much of you, but stay by my side at all costs."
She grips my hand firmly in her own.
I can tell she's ready to go at any moment.
page71.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page71:1

page72.text:
"All right. I'll do my best to follow you, so don't worry about me."
I nod back.
I can barely walk.
We both understand just how bad this is.
But Saber is telling me she will do everything she can to get me through this.
What can I do but agree?
page72.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page72:1

page73.text:
"I have full confidence in you."
Her voice is quiet but firm.
"...Now!"
At that moment, she lets go of my hand to charge ahead.
page73.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page73:1

page74.text:
Both shadows react to her in an instant.
"Gh—!?"
"Wha...!?"
Saber and I are struck dumb.
page74.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page74:1

page75.text:
What just happened?
Lancer jerks his spear off course, away from me...and straight for Gilgamesh, who bats the attack aside with a longsword as if he'd expected it.
page75.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page75:1

page76.text:
"Ah, missed. My bad."
"Ah. Your accuracy certainly leaves something to be desired."
Both men withdraw, unhurried and unconcerned.
page76.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page76:1

page77.text:
"Let me remind you: the mongrel is yours. Saber is mine to deal with, right?"
"My bad, but I don't really care anymore. He didn't give the order with a Command Spell so he can choke for all I care."
As he says this,
Lancer turns to face Gilgamesh, almost as if protecting us.
page77.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page77:1

page78.text:
"Wha—Lancer, you—"
"If you're gonna say something stupid, save your breath. This isn't me helping you. I'm just sticking to my own code."
Lancer levels his spear at Gilgamesh.
His intent is clear: he actually does mean to let us go.
page78.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page78:1

page79.text:
"Honestly, I've had it up to here with him anyway. I'm not doing what he says anymore. I'm cutting Kotomine off right here."
"Oh? You're breaking your contract with him? So you're willing to be eliminated here and now, even with the Grail in reach?"
page79.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page79:1

page80.text:
"I'm nothing like you. I couldn't give less of a shit about having a second life or whatever... No hero worth a damn would care that much for such a thing.
We've got no attachments to this world. Heroes really only care about promises left unfulfilled.
Not that I expect a greedy jackass like you to understand that."
page80.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page80:1

page81.text:
"Is that so? One who experienced such a radiant end must speak thusly. And I suppose this betrayal is owed to a hero's pride as well?
You certainly chose a difficult code to live up to, Lancer."
The air behind Gilgamesh warps.
Weapons appear out of nowhere in the space behind him.
page81.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page81:1

page82.text:
...
"Lancer, he possesses the originals of Noble Phantasms. He is the King of Heroes, the man whose story is the oldest ever recorded. Even you cannot defeat him..."
page82.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page82:1

page83.text: "Damn. A guy who'd destroy his own country to do whatever the hell he wanted... No wonder he's so full of it."
page83.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page83:1

page84.text:
"Lancer, this is no time for bravado—"
"Oh, shut it. You ain't the boss of me. Me defending you here isn't the same as me siding with you.
Man, this is why I can't stand you chivalrous types."
page84.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page84:1

page85.text:
In his own way, Lancer's urging Saber to run.
...
Saber hangs her head for a moment.
"Then farewell. I will return the favor if I can."
Taking my hand, she makes for the stairs.
page85.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page85:1

page86.text:
"Oh, darn. It seems I let them go."
Gilgamesh just watches us, making no move to follow.
page86.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page86:1

page87.text:
"Eh? Wasn't Saber yours?"
"Frankly, the command I was given did not suit me. Had you not done as you have here, I might have done so in your stead."
page87.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page87:1

page88.text:
We make it up the stairs.
Saber must still be worried about how I'm doing, as we don't move very fast.
The pain, on the other hand, doesn't much care how slowly we're moving, as it doesn't dull in the slightest.
The rising tension and sense of impending violence grows.
page88.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page88:1

page89.text: "What's that? You wanted to let Saber go?"
page89.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page89:1

page90.text:
"Of course. I had no intention of killing her. She's mine.
However, I suppose I can't wait about idly if I want the Grail.
I need but one more Servant to die for a complete ritual."
page90.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page90:1

page91.text:
A multitude of swords appears in the darkened basement.
The golden knight smirks.
This was why he was ready for Lancer's surprise attack.
Lancer wasn't the only one planning to turn on his would-be ally.
page91.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page91:1

page92.text:
"Well, shit. So you planned this from the get-go."
"Did you not hear me? We are, I suppose, of like mind in this situation.
I offer my acknowledgement, Cú Chulainn. You have scripted the most pleasant of circumstances."
The two come together.
We make it out just before I see the initial volley.
page92.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-21:page92:1
